Hi Caitlin,

Thanks for writing, and I'm sorry you've had to chase this. Looking at Shop····, your order is paid and your NEXUS QX1 has not shipped yet. The date on your order was October 15, and that has passed with no update sent to you. That silence is on us.

What I don't have is a firm new ship date, and I won't guess at one. A colleague is getting the confirmed date from Nexus and will come back to you by email on this same thread. Your tracking number goes to this address automatically the moment the unit is labelled, so it's worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts in case our mail lands in junk.

Sorry again for the wait and the quiet.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Where things stand: your order is paid and open, your NEXUS QX1 is still unshipped, and no tracking has come through from Nexus yet. For the wait, I've put $25 off your next order on this: code HD-••••••, it's yours alone and works on orders over $100.

They will come back to you by email on this thread.

In the meantime, there is something I can do right now if you would rather not keep waiting. If you would rather hold out for the QX1, that is completely fine too, and your order stays exactly as it is.

Your $25 code from Saturday, HD-••••••, is still on your account for a future order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
